title: The Wednesday run
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The first summer Wednesday. The tech, alone in the shop, the machine, Wood, the dog. No students. The copies come out the same. The tech says that's the thing about a machine. Wood says that's the thing about a strip.

panels.composition: The print shop, summer, the hall outside empty, the lights half on. The TECH. WOOD. BARNABY. The machine.

image.prompt: a college print shop in summer with the hall outside empty and half the lights off, a technician, a young man and a small dog at the copier, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copies coming out. The same. Warm.

image.prompt: close on warm photocopies stacking in a copier's tray, black and white, no words

balloons.text: That's the thing about a machine.
That's the thing about a strip.

image.prompt: a print technician leaning on a quiet copier in an empty shop, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The empty hall. The two of them and the dog in the lit doorway of the print shop, small. Summer. Every Wednesday.
